executive_summary: Maven test compilation failed with 100 errors across 3 test classes. Primary issues include type mismatches between Priority/TaskPriority enums, incorrect method signatures in service interfaces requiring userId parameters, and missing DTO constructors. The codebase appears to have undergone refactoring where test classes were not updated to match new service method signatures and DTO structures.

errors.message: Multiple type incompatibility errors: Priority cannot be converted to TaskPriority, long cannot be converted to UUID/String
errors.root_cause: Test class uses wrong enum type (Priority instead of TaskPriority) and wrong ID types (long instead of UUID/String) throughout multiple test methods
errors.fix_recommendation: Replace all instances of Priority enum with TaskPriority enum. Change all task ID declarations from long to UUID type. Update userId parameters from long to String type.

errors.message: method createTask cannot be applied: required String,TaskCreateRequest found TaskCreateRequest
errors.root_cause: TaskService.createTask() method signature changed to require userId as first parameter but test mocks still use old single-parameter signature
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all when(taskService.createTask(...)) mock statements to include userId as first parameter: when(taskService.createTask(anyString(), any(TaskCreateRequest.class)))

errors.message: method getUserTasks cannot be applied: required String,int,int,String found long,int,int
errors.root_cause: TaskService.getUserTasks() method signature requires userId as String and sortBy parameter, but tests pass long userId without sortBy parameter
errors.fix_recommendation: Update getUserTasks mock calls to: when(taskService.getUserTasks(anyString(), anyInt(), anyInt(), anyString())). Change userId from long to String type.

errors.message: method getTaskById cannot be applied: required UUID,String found long
errors.root_cause: TaskService.getTaskById() method signature changed to require UUID taskId and String userId parameters, but tests use long taskId without userId
errors.fix_recommendation: Update getTaskById calls to use UUID.fromString() for taskId and add userId parameter: when(taskService.getTaskById(any(UUID.class), anyString()))

errors.message: method updateTask cannot be applied: required UUID,String,TaskUpdateRequest found long,TaskUpdateRequest
errors.root_cause: TaskService.updateTask() method signature requires UUID taskId, String userId, and TaskUpdateRequest, but tests provide long taskId without userId
errors.fix_recommendation: Update updateTask mock calls to include UUID taskId and userId: when(taskService.updateTask(any(UUID.class), anyString(), any(TaskUpdateRequest.class)))

errors.message: method deleteTask cannot be applied: required UUID,String found long
errors.root_cause: TaskService.deleteTask() method signature requires UUID taskId and String userId, but tests use long taskId without userId
errors.fix_recommendation: Update deleteTask mock calls to: doNothing().when(taskService).deleteTask(any(UUID.class), anyString()). Change taskId type from long to UUID.

errors.message: method bulkCreateTasks cannot be applied: required String,List<TaskCreateRequest> found Object
errors.root_cause: TaskService.bulkCreateTasks() method signature requires userId as first parameter and properly typed List, but tests pass incorrect types
errors.fix_recommendation: Update bulkCreateTasks mock to: when(taskService.bulkCreateTasks(anyString(), anyList())). Ensure userId parameter is included as String type.

errors.root_cause: GlobalExceptionHandler no longer has handleValidationErrors() method or method was renamed/removed during refactoring
errors.fix_recommendation: Check GlobalExceptionHandler implementation for correct validation error handling method name. Update test to call the correct method or remove test if method was intentionally removed.

errors.message: Multiple errors: Priority/TaskPriority type mismatch, long/String userId incompatibility, missing findAll() and existsById() methods
errors.root_cause: InMemoryTaskDataStore interface changed: userId type changed from long to String, Priority enum changed to TaskPriority, and some methods (findAll, existsById) were removed or renamed
errors.fix_recommendation: Update all userId references from long to String. Replace Priority with TaskPriority enum. Remove or update tests calling findAll() and existsById() methods to use correct datastore API methods.

summary: 9 grouped compilation error categories found affecting 100 individual compilation failures
